categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Refactors message handling in src/net_processing.cpp by breaking up PeerManagerImpl::ProcessMessage().
categories.rationale: Decomposes the monolithic 1,000-line ProcessMessage dispatcher into isolated per-message helpers to improve code navigation and modularity. This is a clean internal refactoring with clear value for net_processing maintenance, but it alters no protocol behavior or DoS defenses.
